trow.definition:
n. A boat with an open well amidships. It is used in spearing
   fish.
v. i. & t. To believe; to trust; to think or suppose.

trowbridge.translation: 特罗布里奇[英国英格兰南部城镇](威尔特郡首府)

trowel.definition:
n. a small hand tool with a handle and flat metal blade; used for scooping or spreading plaster or similar materials
v. use a trowel on; for light garden work or plaster work
trowel.translation:
n. 泥铲, 泥刀
vt. 用泥铲涂

troweler.translation:
n. 【建筑业】(抹灰用的)抹子, 镘子；(砌砖用的)泥刀；(园艺用的)小泥铲；移植铲
vt. 用抹子(或镘子)涂抹(或修平、拌和等)(灰浆)；用小泥铲挖

troweling.definition: v. use a trowel on; for light garden work or plaster work
